variants.final: implementation, without the diagnostic benchmark change

method: All builds, measurements and remote validation serialized with /tmp/core-scheduler-perf.lock. Servers pinned to CPUs 0..workers-1; fixed client uses CPUs 4-7, four workers. Randomized controls use 1s warmup + 3s measurement; counters use zero warmup + 3s; profiles use 1s + 5s. Do not treat instrumented throughput as a capacity result.
result_labels: The final label in deferred-matrix and deferred-profiles identifies the tested 6e52b13 prototype; it is not a merge recommendation.

experiments.baseline: 24 throughput controls, 8 counter samples, 4 cycle profiles
experiments.performance-policy: 36 controls, 3 per case; temporary performance governor, restored
experiments.idle-latency: 18 controls, 3 per case; temporary /dev/cpu_dma_latency request, released
